step1_analysis.circuit_type: Cross-coupled NMOS pair and PMOS bias (VCO / Latch fragment)
step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of a cross-coupled NMOS pair (XM1, XM2) typically used to generate negative resistance in LC VCOs or as a regenerative latch, along with a PMOS transistor (XM3) used for biasing or as a pull-up current source.

paper_reference.title: Low-Power Fully Integrated 10-Gb/s SONET/SDH Transceiver in 0.13-m CMOS

system_power.description: Total power consumption of the entire transceiver.

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric, not applicable to this sub-circuit. Sub-circuit power is ~611uW.

operating_frequency.description: Operating frequency of the transceiver / VCO.

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric. A VCO in SKY130 could be designed for 10GHz but requires the full LC tank.

subcircuit_power.description: DC power consumption of the cross-coupled pair and bias.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 square law parameters.

r_neg.description: Differential negative resistance of the cross-coupled NMOS pair.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard calculation for cross-coupled pair negative resistance.

gm_nmos.description: Transconductance of the cross-coupled NMOS transistors.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from bias current and overdrive voltage.

id_pmos.description: DC drain current of the PMOS bias transistor.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the DC power, PMOS bias current, NMOS transconductance, and differential negative resistance of the cross-coupled pair.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Cross-Coupled Pair Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N1 LABEL_NET_1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
V_N1 N1 0 DC 1.8 AC 1
V_N2 N2 0 DC 1.8 AC -1
V_LABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 DC 0.9
V_LABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 0.9
V_LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 0.9
V_N6 N6 0 DC 0.9

.control
dc VVDD 1.8 1.8 1
let id_m1 = -i(V_N1)
let id_m2 = -i(V_N2)
let id_m3 = -i(V_N6)
let pwr = (-i(VVDD)*1.8) + (-i(V_N1)*1.8) + (-i(V_N2)*1.8) + (-i(V_LABEL_NET_0)*0.9) + (-i(V_LABEL_NET_1)*0.9) + (-i(V_LABEL_NET_2)*0.9) + (-i(V_N6)*0.9)

meas dc id_pmos find id_m3 at=1.8
meas dc subcircuit_power find pwr at=1.8

ac dec 10 1k 100MEG
let i_n1_real = real(i(V_N1))
let r_neg = -2 / i_n1_real
meas ac r_neg_val find r_neg at=1k
let gm_nmos = i_n1_real
meas ac gm_val find gm_nmos at=1k

print id_pmos subcircuit_power r_neg_val gm_val
quit
.endc
.end
